articles.title: Council approves budget
articles.text: The city council approved the 2027 budget on Friday by a vote of 9 to 2. The plan raises the property levy by 3 percent.

articles.title: Budget passes after long debate
articles.text: The city council approved the 2027 budget on Friday by a vote of 9 to 2 after a debate that ran past midnight.

articles.title: What the levy means for owners
articles.text: The property levy rises by 3 percent under the plan the council passed.
